# Design systems that travel

## The opportunity

A reusable brand language should work across reports, presentations, and graphics without recreating visual decisions for every request.

## Operating principles

- Extract observable evidence before asking a model to interpret it.
- Keep artifact planning separate from format-specific rendering.
- Record the exact design-system version behind every output.

## What changes

Teams can spend their creative attention on meaning and narrative while deterministic software handles repeated spacing, typography, rendering, and verification.
